checks.explanation: The Russia-Ukraine war did become protracted over years, though whether it constitutes a "quagmire" in the Vietnam/Iraq sense for the US specifically (which is not a direct combatant) is a debatable framing.
The US remains strategically dependent on Taiwan/TSMC for the most advanced semiconductor manufacturing as of 2026, despite CHIPS Act-driven domestic investment.
Vivek Ramaswamy dropped out of the 2024 Republican primary after the Iowa caucus and endorsed Donald Trump, who went on to win the nomination and the general election.
Spain's July 2023 election produced a hung parliament; the Socialist-led left coalition under Pedro Sánchez ultimately retained government, not a clean shift to the right.
Biden withdrew from the race in July 2024 and was replaced by Kamala Harris, who lost the general election to Trump; Biden did not win as predicted.
